website.summary: Pipeline confirms pevifoscorvir sodium (CAM-E for chronic HBV) and ALG-055009 (THR-beta agonist for MASH) as lead assets

pipeline.modality: Oral small molecule capsid assembly modulator (CAM-E)
pipeline.target: HBV core protein (capsid assembly modulation; prevents pgRNA encapsidation and cccDNA establishment)
pipeline.license_origin: Internal (optimized from in-licensed GLP-26 lead from Prof. Raymond Schinazi, Emory University, 2018)

indications.indication: Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection (HBeAg+ and HBeAg- adults, treatment-naive)
indications.trial_design: Randomized, double-blind, active-controlled multicenter Phase 2 evaluating safety/efficacy of pevifoscorvir sodium monotherapy vs. tenofovir disoproxil fumarate for 48 weeks in approximately 200 currently untreated HBeAg+/- adults; primary endpoint HBV DNA <LLOQ
key_milestones: First interim analysis (HBeAg-, ~36 subjects, 12 weeks): expected 1H 2026
Second interim analysis (HBeAg+, ~55 subjects, 24 weeks): expected 2H 2026

indications.indication: CHB-related Phase 1 special-population PK studies (hepatic and renal impairment)
indications.trial_name: Pevifoscorvir sodium hepatic and renal impairment PK studies
indications.trial_design: Single-dose PK, safety, tolerability of pevifoscorvir sodium in subjects with moderate hepatic impairment or renal impairment vs. healthy controls

pipeline.modality: Oral small molecule THR-beta selective agonist

indications.trial_design: 12-week randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 2a trial evaluating 4 doses of ALG-055009 vs placebo in 102 subjects with presumed F1-F3 MASH; primary endpoint: percent relative change in liver fat content by MRI-PDFF at Week 12 (met)
indications.trial_status: Completed (met primary endpoint; up to 46.2% placebo-adjusted median relative liver fat reduction)
key_milestones: HERALD readout: up to 46.2% relative liver fat reduction; positive lipid effects
Aligos evaluating options including out-licensing to fund continued development

pipeline.modality: Oral small molecule pan-coronavirus 3CL protease inhibitor (ritonavir-free)

indications.trial_design: Phase 2 clinical study in standard and high-risk COVID-19 patients (per 10-K narrative); follows completed Phase 1 SAD/MAD and special-population PK studies
indications.lead_sponsor: Aligos Therapeutics (with NIAID collaboration on hepatic/renal PK)

excluded_preclinical: ALG-170675 (HBV next-generation ASO with TLR-8 agonism) — IND-enabling, partnered with Xiamen Amoytop Biotech (Amoytop funds China development)
HDV ASO program — clinical development candidate selection ongoing
